texts: Baker Mayfield dislocated his right thumb Sunday and Todd Bowles says he is out at least three weeks. Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starts vs GB. Hold Mayfield. Let's dive in. #GoBucs

The MRI on Baker Mayfield's thumb showed no fracture and no ligament or tendon damage. Jalon Daniels went 0 for 3 with a game-ending interception in relief. Hold Mayfield through the three weeks. Drop him only if the timeline slips past Week 7. #GoBucs
